how.title: How Bufano Redirect works
how.subtitle: From your free US address to a consolidated box at your door — here is exactly what happens at every step.

steps.title: Get your US address
steps.text: Sign up for free in a couple of minutes and receive a personal US shipping address tied to your account. There are no setup fees and no commitment — you can start using it right away for any store that ships within the US.

steps.title: Shop US stores and ship to it
steps.text: Use your new address at checkout on Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and hundreds of other US retailers, exactly like a local shopper would. Buy from as many stores as you like — every order will arrive at the same place.

steps.title: Your packages arrive at our warehouse
steps.text: As soon as a package reaches our facility, we scan it in, photograph its condition and label it to your account. You get an email notification and can see the photos and details in your dashboard right away.

steps.title: We consolidate and repackage
steps.text: Once your orders have arrived, request a consolidation. Our team removes unnecessary packaging, combines everything into the smallest possible box and lets you know the new weight and dimensions before you pay for shipping.

steps.title: We ship worldwide
steps.text: Choose the carrier and speed that fit your budget, pay online and track your box from our warehouse to your door. We deliver to more than 200 countries with trusted international carriers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about your US address, shipping, storage and your account. Can't find an answer? Reach out to our support team.

items.a: Bufano Redirect is a package forwarding service that gives you a free personal US address, so you can shop at American stores that don't ship internationally and have your orders consolidated and forwarded to your door anywhere in the world.

items.q: How do I get my US address?
items.a: Create a free account and your personal US shipping address is generated instantly. You can start using it at checkout on any US store right away.
Yes. Creating an account and receiving your US address costs nothing. You only pay for the services you actually use, like consolidation, storage beyond the free period, and shipping.
Signup takes just a couple of minutes. As soon as you confirm your email, your US address is ready to use for shopping.

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We ship to more than 200 countries worldwide through trusted international carriers. You can check delivery estimates for your destination on the shipping calculator page.

items.q: How are duties and taxes handled?
items.a: Import duties and taxes are set by your country's customs authority and are not included in our shipping fees. They are typically charged by the carrier or customs office upon arrival, based on the declared value of your package.
Yes. Once your consolidated package ships, you receive a tracking number and can follow its journey from our warehouse to your door directly from your dashboard.

Some items, such as flammable liquids, weapons, and certain batteries, cannot be shipped internationally due to carrier and customs regulations. Check our shipping policy or contact support if you're unsure about a specific item.

items.q: How long can my packages be stored?
items.a: Free accounts include 7 days of storage per package. Premium members enjoy extended storage of 45 to 90 days, giving you more time to wait for multiple orders before consolidating.

items.q: How much can I save by consolidating?
items.a: Consolidating multiple packages into a single shipment can cut your shipping cost by up to 80%, since you pay one shipping fee instead of several. Use our calculator to estimate your savings.
Free accounts pay a small fee per additional photo beyond the first. Premium members receive photos of every package at no extra cost.

items.q: What is repackaging and does it cost extra?
items.a: Repackaging means removing bulky retail boxes and combining your items into the smallest possible box to reduce weight and dimensions. It's available for a small fee and often pays for itself in shipping savings.

items.q: Can I change my plan later?
items.a: Yes, you can upgrade from Free to Premium, or adjust your plan at any time from your account settings. Changes take effect immediately.
Our support team is available by email and through the contact form on our website, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (EST). We aim to respond within one business day.
Yes. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data and never share your personal information with third parties without your consent.

items.q: Can I cancel my account at any time?
items.a: Absolutely. You can cancel your account at any time from your account settings with no cancellation fees. Any packages in storage should be shipped or picked up beforehand.

about.title: About Bufano Redirect
about.subtitle: We help shoppers around the world access American stores by giving them a real US address and a simpler, cheaper way to ship their purchases home.
mission: Bufano Redirect was built for the millions of shoppers who find a product they love on a US store, only to discover it doesn't ship to their country. We solve that by giving every customer a free, personal US shipping address in minutes.

Once your packages arrive at our warehouse, we photograph them, hold them safely, and consolidate multiple orders into a single box before shipping worldwide. That means you shop as many US stores as you like and pay for one shipment instead of many.
Our goal is simple: make shopping in the US feel local, no matter where you live, while keeping the process transparent, affordable, and easy to trust.

terms.draftNotice: Draft — placeholder legal text, replace with reviewed copy before launch.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using Bufano Redirect's website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Description of service
sections.body: Bufano Redirect provides customers with a personal US shipping address, package receiving, consolidation, repackaging, and international forwarding services. Features and availability may change over time as we improve our platform.

sections.heading: 3. Account registration
sections.body: To use our services you must create an account with accurate, current information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account.

sections.heading: 4. Prohibited items
sections.body: Certain items, including flammable liquids, weapons, and specific batteries, cannot be accepted or shipped due to carrier and customs regulations. We reserve the right to refuse, hold, or dispose of any package that violates this policy.

sections.heading: 5. Fees and payment
sections.body: Consolidation, storage beyond the included period, repackaging, and shipping are billed according to our published fee schedule. Prices are estimates until checkout, when final charges are calculated based on actual weight and dimensions.

sections.heading: 6. Shipping and liability
sections.body: We ship packages using trusted third-party carriers and are not responsible for delays, customs seizures, or duties imposed by destination countries. Optional value protection is available to cover loss or damage during transit.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Bufano Redirect's liability for any claim related to our services is limited to the fees you paid for the specific shipment in question. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms. We recommend checking this page periodically.

privacy.draftNotice: Draft — placeholder legal text, replace with reviewed copy before launch.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide when creating an account, such as your name, email address, and shipping details, as well as information generated when you use our services, like package and shipment records.

sections.heading: 2. How we use information
sections.body: We use your information to provide and improve our services, process shipments, communicate with you about your packages, and respond to support requests. We do not use your data for purposes unrelated to these goals without your consent.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies
sections.body: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences, and understand how our site is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: We share information only with service providers who help us operate, such as shipping carriers and payment processors, and only to the extent necessary to deliver our services. We never sell your personal information.

sections.heading: 5. Data security
sections.body: We use industry-standard encryption and access controls to protect your data. While no system is completely secure, we continuously review our practices to reduce risk.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Contact our support team to exercise these rights, and we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: 7. International transfers
sections.body: Because we operate a worldwide shipping service, your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own, including the United States, under appropriate safeguards.

sections.heading: 8. Contact us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, reach out to our support team through the contact page and we'll be happy to help.
